name: Equal Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as equal.vc, the New York seed firm that backs founders applying technology in legacy industries (insurance, logistics, retail, climate); team page names Jon Healy, Rick Zullo and others, portfolio includes Odyssey and Equal Parts. Not Equal (Equal AI / Equal Identity, a Prosus-backed Indian data-sharing company), not Equal Opportunity Ventures.
